en.title: Chiefs vs. Seahawks Sunday Night Football Game Set for Oct. 25
en.dek: Kansas City Chiefs face Seattle Seahawks in a Sunday Night Football matchup at Lumen Field, with odds favoring Seattle.
facts: Game scheduled Sunday Oct. 25 at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC.
Kansas City Chiefs are 5‑0, Seattle Seahawks 3‑3.
Seattle is a 3‑point favorite; over/under set at 42.5 points.
Chiefs lead all‑time series 34‑19 and have won four of last five meetings.
Kalshi predicts 42% chance Chiefs win, 58% chance Seahawks win.
body: The Sunday Night Football matchup between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Seattle Seahawks will take place at Lumen Field in Seattle on Sunday, Oct. 25. The kickoff is scheduled for 8:20 p.m. ET and the game will be broadcast on NBC.
Kansas City enters the game undefeated at 5‑0 after a 22‑6 win over the Los Angeles Chargers. Seattle is 3‑3, having lost its last two games to the San Francisco 49ers and Denver Broncos.

Betting lines list Seattle as a 3‑point favorite and set the over/under for total points at 42.5. The money line shows Seattle at –162, while the Chiefs have a 3‑2 record against the spread and Seattle a 1‑3‑2 record.

Kalshi markets the game with a 42% probability for a Chiefs win and 58% for a Seahawks win. The SportsLine model projects the Chiefs winning 43% of simulated games and the Seahawks 58%, with the over 42.5 points occurring in about 54–57% of simulations.
The Chiefs have a 3‑2 record against the spread and Seattle a 1‑3‑2 record. The model also indicates the over 42.5 points hits 54% of the time in its 10,000‑game simulations.

Free streaming options include a five‑day trial from DirecTV or Fubo, both of which provide access to NBC for the game. After the trial, DirecTV costs $44.99 per month and Fubo $88.99 per month, though discounted rates are available for the first month.
en.context: Sunday Night Football is a weekly broadcast that features a single NFL game on NBC. The Chiefs‑Seahawks matchup is part of Week 7 of the 2026 NFL season.

ja.title: カンザスシティ・チーフス対シアトル・シーホークス、10月25日の日曜ナイトフットボール試合が決定

シアトルは3勝3敗で、直近2試合はサンフランシスコ・49ersとデンバー・ブロンコスに敗れている。
